# Gold PDF

> Gold PDF (pdf.gold) is a free PDF editor for Windows 10 and 11. It edits the text already inside a PDF, redacts for real (the original content is removed from the file, not just covered), recognises text on scanned pages (OCR), fills forms, saves signatures, adds AES-256 passwords, merges, reorders and extracts pages, and has an optional AI assistant that uses the user's own API key. The interface comes in 30 languages and everything runs offline on the user's computer.

## Facts
- Price: free, no account, no watermark, no trial period.
- Platform: Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit (no Mac or mobile version yet). Installer about 118 MB.
- Privacy: files never leave the computer. The optional AI feature sends only the open document's text lines and the user's instruction to the provider the user chooses, only when they press Run.
- Languages: 30 interface languages. New text can be typed in Latin, Greek, Cyrillic, Hebrew, Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Hindi and Thai.
- OCR: English and Hebrew work offline; other languages download once on first use.
- AI providers (bring your own key): Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, Mistral, Cerebras, GitHub Models, Cohere, NVIDIA, Hugging Face, Cloudflare, Alibaba, Z.ai, SiliconFlow.
- Limits: very complex mixed-direction text deserves a visual check.

## Free browser tools (no upload, no watermark)
- [Merge PDF](https://pdf.gold/tools/merge-pdf/): Combine several PDFs into one document in your browser. Free, no sign-up, no watermark, and your files never leave your device.
- [Split PDF](https://pdf.gold/tools/split-pdf/): Split a PDF by page ranges or into single pages, right in your browser. No upload, no watermark, no account.
- [Extract pages](https://pdf.gold/tools/extract-pdf-pages/): Pull selected pages out of a PDF into a new, smaller file. Free, private and instant — runs in your browser.
- [Delete pages](https://pdf.gold/tools/delete-pdf-pages/): Remove blank, duplicate or unwanted pages from a PDF in seconds. Free, no watermark, and the file stays on your device.
- [Rotate PDF](https://pdf.gold/tools/rotate-pdf/): Rotate all or selected pages of a PDF by 90, 180 or 270 degrees and save the fixed file. No upload, no watermark.
- [Compress PDF](https://pdf.gold/tools/compress-pdf/): Make a large PDF smaller for email and forms. Free, runs in your browser, your document is never uploaded.
- [PDF to JPG](https://pdf.gold/tools/pdf-to-jpg/): Turn every page of a PDF into a high-quality JPG or PNG. Free, no upload, no watermark.
- [JPG to PDF](https://pdf.gold/tools/jpg-to-pdf/): Turn photos and screenshots into one PDF, in your order. Free, private, no watermark.
- [Page numbers](https://pdf.gold/tools/add-page-numbers-to-pdf/): Number the pages of any PDF: choose position, starting number and format. No upload, no watermark.
- [Watermark PDF](https://pdf.gold/tools/watermark-pdf/): Stamp DRAFT, CONFIDENTIAL or your own text across every page of a PDF. No upload, no sign-up.
- [PDF to text](https://pdf.gold/tools/pdf-to-text/): Pull all selectable text out of a PDF and copy or download it as a .txt file. Free, private, runs in your browser.
- [Protect PDF](https://pdf.gold/tools/protect-pdf-with-password/): Add a password to a PDF so only people with the password can open it. Strong encryption, no upload, free.
- [Unlock PDF](https://pdf.gold/tools/unlock-pdf/): Remove the open-password from your own PDF so it opens without asking. Free, private, runs in your browser.
